newsitem.title: DUBAI: Force 5.9 quake hits northeast Iran province - IRNA.
newsitem.headline: Force 5.9 quake hits northeast Iran province - IRNA.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.9 on the Richter scale jolted Birjand in northeastern Iran but there were no immediate reports of casualties or damage, the official Iranian news agency IRNA reported on Saturday.

The quake, which hit at 5.28 p.m. on Friday (1258 GMT), was considered an aftershock of the force 7.1 earthquake which hit Birjand and Qaen on May 10, killing more than 1,500 people and making 50,000 homeless, IRNA said.
The geophysics institute of Tehran University said the epicenter of the quake was 460 km (285 miles) south of Mashhad.

Iran has been hit by at least three major earthquakes in the past year as well as scores of milder tremors and thousands of aftershocks that U.N. officials say have stretched Iran's relief supplies to the limit.
Earthquakes measuring force 4 and above can cause widespread damage in a populated area.
